title: [ISSUE #5740] Fix util.getIP sometimes choose localhost over LAN ip.

timeline.body:
**Make sure set the target branch to `develop`**

## What is the purpose of the change
fix #5740

## Brief changelog
According to RFC 1122, { 127, any } are reserved for internal host loopback address.So `isInternalIP` function return true when ip is between 127.0.0.0~127.255.255.255.
And now it prefers LAN ip to localhost(internal host loopback address).

This judgment changes the behavior of the getIP function. If we only have lo interface, getIP will throw RuntimeException.

reply.body:
If we only have lo interface,`internalIP == null || internalIP[0] == (byte) 127)` will be true，so it will set `internalIP` to localhost and return.
If we have lo and LAN ip，when it find the LAN ip，`internalIP == null || internalIP[0] == (byte) 127)` also will be true, so it will override the value of `internalIP`.
Am I missing something？
You are right. Please ignore this review.
